```python
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [0.5, 0.75, 0.95]
}
df = nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(data))

# Convert columns to specified dtypes
result_df = df.select([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
])

print(result_df)
```
